summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Toro Energy Limited via a scheme of arrangement under Australian law. Toro shareholders received 0.036 IsoEnergy common shares per Toro share; approximately 4,359,568 ISO Shares were issued. The deal was approved by Toro shareholders on June 9, 2026, and by the Federal Court of Australia on June 15, 2026, becoming effective June 16, 2026. Toro shares were suspended from ASX trading and will be delisted. IsoEnergy's CEO commented on strategic benefits of the Wiluna Uranium Project. Watch for integration updates and uranium market conditions affecting combined portfolio.
